quest.title: Herbalist's Forage
quest.description: Liyue Harbor's Herbalist Gui needs three Qingxin.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Ah yes, you must've seen my commission then. I'm happy someone has finally turned up to help.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: So, how goes the search for those three Qingxin flowers? Have you got them yet?

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: Just remember to bring them back to me once you've gathered them. We've got medicine to make and people to cure.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Not bad, these Qingxin flowers will do just fine. Thanks a lot. Here, take these.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: I'll get these Qingxin flowers delivered right away. We have patients depending on it to get better.
